get.description: Public, no auth: exactly what the link exposes. 404 when the link is unknown, revoked or expired.
Validate an authorization request for the consent screen (client name, device name).

post.description: The signed-in user approves the app: a single-use code valid 60 s and the redirect URL.
Revoke the API token this request is authenticated with (`Authorization: Token ...`).

Exchange the code (`grant_type=authorization_code`, `code`, `code_verifier`, `redirect_uri`,
`client_id`; form or JSON) for an API token named «Hearfolio · {device_name}». Errors use the RFC 6749
body `{error, error_description}`: 400 `invalid_request | invalid_client | invalid_grant |
unsupported_grant_type`, 429 `rate_limited`.

schema.description: RFC 6749 §4.1.3 + RFC 7636. Sent as form (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`) or JSON.

AIConnectionTestSchema.title: AIConnectionTestSchema
AIConnectionTestSchema.description: Values to check before saving them; omitted fields use the saved settings.

AIOptionsSchema.title: AIOptionsSchema
AIOptionsSchema.description: What members may choose; no secrets.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: The error envelope every non-2xx response uses (`ResultData` with an error); documented on every operation.

InviteAcceptSchema.title: InviteAcceptSchema
InviteAcceptSchema.description: Anonymous accept: the account to create. Ignored when the request is signed in.

InvitePreviewSchema.title: InvitePreviewSchema
InvitePreviewSchema.description: What the public invite page shows before accepting.

MeSchema.title: MeSchema
MeSchema.description: What a client needs to bootstrap: the user (with `is_superuser`) and the organizations they belong to.

OAuthAuthorizeInfoSchema.title: OAuthAuthorizeInfoSchema
OAuthAuthorizeInfoSchema.description: A validated authorization request, for the consent screen.

OAuthAuthorizeRequest.title: OAuthAuthorizeRequest
OAuthAuthorizeRequest.description: What the native app put into `/oauth/authorize?...`, forwarded by the consent page.

OAuthAuthorizeResponse.title: OAuthAuthorizeResponse
OAuthAuthorizeResponse.description: The single-use code (valid 60 s) and where to send the browser: `redirect_uri?code=...&state=...`.

OAuthTokenResponse.title: OAuthTokenResponse
OAuthTokenResponse.description: A regular named API token (`Authorization: Token <access_token>`), plus the user and their organizations.

OrganizationInviteCreatedSchema.title: OrganizationInviteCreatedSchema
OrganizationInviteCreatedSchema.description: Returned once on creation: the raw token and the link to share. Neither can be read again.

OrganizationSettingsReadSchema.title: OrganizationSettingsReadSchema
OrganizationSettingsReadSchema.description: AI settings as org admins see them; the API key itself is never returned.

OrganizationSettingsUpdateSchema.title: OrganizationSettingsUpdateSchema
OrganizationSettingsUpdateSchema.description: Partial update. `openrouter_api_key`: omitted keeps the key, `""` or null removes it, a value replaces it.

OrganizationUserCreateSchema.title: OrganizationUserCreateSchema
OrganizationUserCreateSchema.description: The organization is explicit (not `Organization-Key`): members are managed from the organization's page.

OrganizationUserUpdateSchema.title: OrganizationUserUpdateSchema
OrganizationUserUpdateSchema.description: Only the role changes; user and organization are fixed after creation. Omitted role → unchanged.

PublicShareSchema.title: PublicShareSchema
PublicShareSchema.description: Exactly what the link exposes; `audio` is a short-lived presigned URL.

RecordingCreateSchema.title: RecordingCreateSchema
RecordingCreateSchema.description:
Create a recording before its audio is uploaded. Re-sending the same `client_id` returns the existing recording.
With `transcript_text` (an already transcribed local recording) no transcription runs.

RecordingReadSchema.title: RecordingReadSchema
RecordingReadSchema.description: What the list shows. `snippet` is set only by a search: transcript fragment split into highlighted parts.

RecordingResultsCreateSchema.title: RecordingResultsCreateSchema
RecordingResultsCreateSchema.description: Summaries to make: one per template plus one for `custom_prompt`; `model` defaults to the organization's.

RecordingSyncSchema.title: RecordingSyncSchema
RecordingSyncSchema.description:
Changes after `cursor`, ordered by (updated_at, id). `deleted_ids`: recordings the client must drop if it has
them (deleted, or no longer visible to the caller). Pass `next_cursor` back until `has_more` is false.

RecordingUpdateSchema.title: RecordingUpdateSchema
RecordingUpdateSchema.description: Anyone who sees the recording may rename, move between visible projects and edit tags. Visibility: author only.

RetranscribeSchema.title: RetranscribeSchema
RetranscribeSchema.description: `model` must be an allowed transcription model; omitted means the organization's default.

SessionExpirySchema.title: SessionExpirySchema
SessionExpirySchema.description: When the session cookies expire. The tokens themselves never leave the HttpOnly cookies.

SessionSchema.title: SessionSchema
SessionSchema.description: Login response: the bootstrap data plus cookie expiry.

url.title: Url
url.description: The public page `{PUBLIC_URL}/s/{token}`; null when PUBLIC_URL is not configured.

TagMergeSchema.title: TagMergeSchema
TagMergeSchema.description: Move every recording of this tag to `target_id`, then delete this tag.

UploadPlanSchema.title: UploadPlanSchema
UploadPlanSchema.description:
`single`: PUT the whole file to `url` with the `headers`. `multipart`: PUT each part (`part_size` bytes, the
last one shorter) to its URL, keep each response's `ETag`, then call `upload/complete`.

UserOrganizationSchema.title: UserOrganizationSchema
UserOrganizationSchema.description: An organization of the current user together with the user's role in it.

cookieAuth.name: access_token
cookieAuth.description: HttpOnly session cookie set by `POST /api/v1/auth/login`. Unsafe methods also need a trusted `Origin` (or `Referer`).

bearerAuth.description: Access JWT minted server-side (tests, scripts). Browsers use the cookie.
